nom: COOLA Organic Classic Face Sunscreen SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are divided: several say it balances their skin without extra shine or clogged pores, while others — including two critical reviewers — report it turns oily and unmatte, or needs powder to mattify, especially at a full application amount.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly describe it as deeply hydrating and comfortable layered over a moisturizer, though one reviewer notes the formula can start to feel tight after a while and may need a moisturizer underneath for dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin generally find it balances oily and dry patches without excess shine, though one found that applying slightly more than recommended left her skin sticky with a visible white cast.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation or breakouts and specifically credit the fragrance-free version, though one reviewer developed a spreading dermatitis rash that her dermatologist linked to this chemical (non-mineral) sunscreen.
segments.normal: The reviewers with normal, or normal-to-dry, skin report no irritation or breakouts and say the formula suits their skin well.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers across dry, combination and normal skin report the formula hydrates well and can even replace a separate moisturizer; one reviewer says it starts to feel tight on her skin after a while and recommends layering a moisturizer underneath.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who say they normally burn or flush easily report reduced redness and no burning sensation, including one whose skin barrier was already compromised and irritated; one reviewer, in contrast, reports the opposite — that the sunscreen left her face burnt and red after less than an hour outside.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers dealing with a compromised skin barrier, including one recovering from retinol-related damage, describe the formula as calming and comfortable rather than irritating.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report visible results on pigmentation: one says her dark spots faded alongside her acne improving, another says it keeps her dark spots 'in check,' and a reviewer with melasma reports no new or worsening dark spots after wearing it in the sun.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone, report no new breakouts and credit the non-comedogenic formula; one reviewer notes that a scented version of the product (cucumber) irritated her skin, though the fragrance-free version did not.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers are split: several with oily or combination-oily skin say it absorbs to a balanced, non-greasy finish, while others — including two critical reviewers with oily skin — describe it as extremely greasy or oily-looking and needing blotting powder to mattify, especially at a full three-finger application.

aspects.libelle: No white cast across skin tones
Pricey but seen as worth it

extraits.titre: Loved this product until it caused a reaction
extraits.texte: I used this daily on my face for months, and loved the lightweight feel. Unfortunately I started getting a dermatitis rash that has since spread, and the one factor that seems to be consistent in my routine is this sunscreen, confirmed by my dermatologist since it is not mineral based. I am sad that I have new bottles I can no longer use, and wish I had realized sooner that it was not mineral based.

this is a decent face sunscreen with a rich, creamy texture, minimal fragrance, and no white cast once absorbed. my biggest gripe, though, is that it's extremely greasy. i can't imagine reapplying this sunscreen more than once. that said, it wears well under makeup. i found it moisturizing and helpful for keeping my base makeup smooth. but as an everyday sunscreen without makeup, the greasiness can be a sensory nightmare, especially since i also wear glasses. if you have oily skin, i would not recommend this sunscreen because i did need to powder twice throughout the day even with my oil proof makeup routine. on the plus side, it has spf 50, which is more than enough.this product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Sunscreen is a huge part of my everyday skincare routine and honestly it is one of my favorite skincare products. As someone who religiously wears sunscreen (alone/under makeup), I absolutely adore Organic SPF 50 Classic Face Sunscreen by COOLA. I am a big fan of everything from COOLA and have been using so many of COOLA sunscreens for years. I genuinely love and enjoy their products and I have to say, this organic sunscreen is probably one of my favorite COOLA face sunscreens. It is fragrance-free, lightweight and absorbs quickly. No white cast and does not burn my eyes! I have combination skin and it does not feel greasy, sticky or heavy on the skin. It feels and soaks in like a moisturizer, rather than a sunscreen. It is very hydrating and nourishing! I usually like to wear a moisturizer under sunscreen but with this one, I can skip the moisturizer and just wear sunscreen alone. I love that it eliminates an extra step and makes my morning routine so much easier and quicker. Although I do not have sensitive skin, unfortunately I am currently dealing with dry, flaky skin and redness around my mouth due to skin barrier being damaged. This sunscreen felt comfortable and did not irritate my skin. I appreciate the high SPF 50 protection. I always prefer SPF 50 or more since UV index is pretty high in Texas. My friends call me a sunscreen snob and it might be true! I have tried so many sunscreens over the past few years and am very particular. This one checks all my boxes. It really feels like skincare when you apply it—it's lightweight, hydrating and absorbs incredibly quickly into your skin. It does not leave any white cast or greasy feeling on your skin. I love that it is fragrance free as perfumed products can irritate my skin. This did not runoff into my eyes and causing burning when I sweated—I am an avid outdoor runner so I do consider this a true test of whether or not I will repurchase a particular sunscreen product. I also have melasma and is easily aggravated by sun exposure. I did not notice any new or worsening dark spots when I wore this sunscreen. This was my first experience with this brand and I would enthusiastically recommend. As someone with dry, sensitive skin, I'm always on the hunt for a sunscreen that won't irritate or leave me feeling greasy. Coola's Fragrance-Free Classic Face Sunscreen SPF 50 checks a lot of boxes! It has a lightweight, almost serum-like texture that blends in easily without leaving a white cast. I love that it's organic and reef-safe, plus it feels hydrating without clogging my pores.I tend to gravitate towards mineral sunscreens - so I was hesitant with this being chemical based. While I haven't experienced any eye stinging or pain, I did notice my eyes watering during wear. That said, it wears beautifully under makeup and hasn't caused any breakouts or irritation, which is a huge win for my sensitive skin. As a Taz user, it didn't cling to any of my dry patches. Price is comparable to other sunscreens on the market. Overall, a great sunscreen! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I use this sunscreen as the last step in my morning routine, and I love how lightweight it feels. It absorbs quickly with no white cast, no greasy residue. I also really like that it has SPF 50 and organic ingredients. What I don't love is that after a while, it starts to feel a bit tight on my skin, so it may not be the best for dry skin. I'd recommend using a good moisturizer underneath. Other than that, it's a great addition to my skincare routine.
